name: @paperclipai/mcp-connector
description: Outbound connector that lets Paperclip agents use private-network MCP servers through the governed gateway, without exposing them or weakening the server's SSRF guard.

scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "import esbuild from 'esbuild'; import config from './esbuild.config.mjs'; await esbuild.build(config);" && chmod +x dist/main.js
